Your estimated value

Add your car details and select “Estimate” to see a valuation.
How to read this: This is an indicative estimate from comparable listings, not an appraisal or guaranteed sale price.

How the estimate works

The model finds comparable listings using brand, model, age, mileage, condition, fuel, transmission, and accident history. It weights closer matches more heavily and reports the weighted median price. The 1–5 rating adjusts the match toward listings with better or worse condition.

Dataset has 50,000 records. The supplied data has no currency/location selector, maintenance history, trim, or market date field. Estimates may be less reliable for rare combinations; actual prices vary by local market and vehicle specifics.
